Explain in a short self-contained paragraph why a bicycle tyre feels softer on a cold morning, without numbers. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: When the morning air cools, the gas molecules inside your bicycle tyre lose thermal energy and slow down. This reduces their collisions against the inner tube, dropping the internal pressure and making the tyre feel softer.
